Proaction's impressive 60% sales increase, aided by Codex, showcases how AI can streamline fleet management solutions, saving over 75 hours in operations. The launch of Gemini 3.8 Live introduces a new Live Avatar, revolutionizing user interaction and experience. Google Beam's expansion into five additional countries, in partnership with Industrious, promises to enhance service accessibility for users. items.original: Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics. Robots are getting smarter, but how can their hardware match that growth? New Microsoft Research findings show that moving AI inference beyond the robot can improve task success, boost efficiency, and support more advanced physical AI workloads. The post Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Microsoft Research has published findings on improving the capabilities of physical robots by offloading AI inference tasks. This approach allows robots to become more efficient and successful in completing tasks by processing AI functions externally, rather than relying solely on their onboard hardware.

items.original: Show HN: AI·rete·RAG – a Rete rule engine decides, RAG explains why
items.rewritten: AI·rete·RAG is a tool that uses a Rete rule engine to make decisions. It also provides explanations for those decisions through a feature called RAG. This combination helps users understand the reasoning behind the AI's choices.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a unique tool that incorporates a diffusion image model directly within a PDF file. This allows users to create and share images in a format that is easily accessible and portable. It combines advanced image processing with the convenience of PDF.

items.original: Show HN: Agenttik – work on multiple projects in parallel with AI agents
items.rewritten: Agenttik is a tool designed to help users manage multiple projects simultaneously with the assistance of AI agents. It allows for parallel work, improving efficiency and productivity. This can be particularly useful for teams juggling various tasks.

items.original: Show HN: Alyph, a manual transmission for LLM context
items.rewritten: Alyph is a tool that serves as a manual transmission for managing context in large language models (LLMs). It provides users with more control over how context is handled, allowing for more precise interactions with the AI. This can enhance the overall effectiveness of using LLMs.
